purpose: Define how the three horizontal navigation planes, the vertical Axis/Tree structures, and religious/comparative subjects intersect so the Potato House can answer where something belongs and what it leads to.
master_rule: This file coordinates three navigation decks/projections around the Axis and vertical Tree routes. The canonical geometric Plane is separately defined by data/house/plane-crossing-contract.json. Rooms own subjects; decks project them; Trees route vertically; corridors relate them. The generic Tree operator and family typing are governed by data/house/tree-family-contract.json.

centerline.label: Axis
centerline.role: exact spatial center through all three planes
centerline.rule: The Axis is the shared vertical reference. It is not a Room and does not own knowledge.

heaven-plane.label: Crown Junction
heaven-plane.meaning: Canopy, integration, orientation, Garden-facing return and upper-axis comparison.

world-plane.label: Door / Cross Junction
world-plane.meaning: Door/Cross junction as represented on the World navigation deck; the exact geometric O remains Axis∩active Plane under the Plane contract.

below-plane.label: Root Junction
below-plane.meaning: Buried provenance, memory and the root fork where material can become Living Root/Soil or remain Ash/Strife.

inner_ring.label: Research Lab / Forge
inner_ring.role: provisional cross-Room testing around the Axis
inner_ring.rule: Research surrounds the center because unresolved material is inspected and transformed here before being promoted into a stable Room relation or pathway.

outer_ring.label: Works / Fruit
outer_ring.rule: Works occupy the output edge because fruit may emerge from any direction and later return as seed.

planes.label: Heaven Plane
planes.canonical_plane_relation: A symbolic navigation projection at another vertical/depth emphasis; not the canonical Plane operator.

planes.label: World Plane
planes.canonical_plane_relation: Often aligned with the active World-facing Plane for reader navigation, but not identical to the mathematical/frame operator.

planes.label: Below Plane
planes.canonical_plane_relation: A symbolic navigation projection at another vertical/depth emphasis; not the canonical Plane operator.

vertical_organisms.label: Akashic Tree
vertical_organisms.boundary: Archive metaphor only; not evidence for a literal supernatural Akashic Record.

vertical_organisms.label: Tree of Knowledge
vertical_organisms.anchor: World Door/Cross with roots into Below
vertical_organisms.rule: Knowledge introduces distinction, memory, responsibility and consequence. It is upstream of both Life and Strife.

vertical_organisms.label: Tree of Life
vertical_organisms.test: Does the relation create nourishment, differentiation, autonomous future capacity and accountable return?

vertical_organisms.label: Tree of Strife
vertical_organisms.test: Does the relation require unresolved conflict, capture, repetition or blocked correction in order to keep reproducing?
vertical_organisms.ash_rule: Roots of Ash are a principal root-state feeding Tree of Strife when residue remains unresolved. Ash is not permanently Strife: through evidence, acknowledgment and repair it can become Soil/Living Root.

routes.note: The visible Tree of Strife can grow into World culture/institutions while its sustaining roots remain Below.

subject_placement_rules.rule: Anchor in the source tradition's celestial/messenger role; World holds texts, appearances, ritual and historical reception. Do not treat 'angel' as a generic label for admired people.
Anchor in tradition-specific demonology/adversarial roles and dated reception. Do not infer literal demonic identity for people, groups or disliked traditions.
Own-tradition theology/myth first; World holds cult, texts, institutions and reception. Chthonic/death aspects may also anchor Below.
Below is appropriate because the source tradition itself places them in death/underworld/descent functions, not because they are automatically evil.
Spirits are usually better treated as tradition-specific beings or flow/mediation concepts that can cross planes than as permanent residents of one floor.
Historical school and practice belong on World; hidden/initiation/descent material may use Below; ascent cosmologies may project to Heaven.
Treat as historically documented religious/subcultural movements. Do not merge them with demonology, occultism or high-control analysis.
Placement follows observable control/capture mechanisms, not religious or esoteric labels.

navigation_law.compass: Which subject family am I facing?
navigation_law.tree: What path of growth, descent, recurrence or repair connects levels?
navigation_law.corridor: What typed relation lets me cross to another Room?
navigation_law.fruit_ring: What has been produced and returned?

naming_boundary.canonical_plane: data/house/plane-crossing-contract.json defines Plane as a frame-relative section/hypersurface through the larger system.
naming_boundary.navigation_planes: The labels Heaven Plane, World Plane and Below Plane in this file are navigation decks/projections, not three instances of the canonical geometric Plane operator.
naming_boundary.rule: Keep stable IDs for compatibility, but public/explanatory text should distinguish navigation deck from geometric Plane whenever ambiguity matters.

tree_type_rule: Every vertical Tree in this file must remain typed: archive/Akashic, Knowledge fork, Life generative route or Strife reproductive failure pattern.
